summary: [P2] Listen for text submission after replacing searchable
failure_scenario: Enter a task query and press the keyboard Search key. This delta replaces searchable with NanoSearchField, whose control is a regular TextField, but leaves onSubmit(of: .search). SwiftUI defines .search triggers for searchable controls and .text for TextField; submitLabel(.search) only sets the label. The submit action therefore does not invoke load(), so the old results remain until the unrelated three-second polling refresh. Use the default/text submit trigger for this field to preserve immediate submitted-query behavior.
